title: pane.list
description: Lists the session's panes, with nothing from any screen. Needs hello version 2 and a caller with a controlling terminal, in a pane or not; a caller with none is refused.

id.description: The pane's number, never reused in a session.

title.description: The last name of cwd, as the pane's tab shows it.

cwd.description: The last directory the pane reported with OSC 7. Program output can fake it.

command.description: The program the pane started, without its arguments.

status.description: The last pane.status report, or else the shell's OSC 133 marks, which output can fake; done once the pane's program has ended.

source.description: Where status came from: OSC 133 marks, which output can fake, or a pane.status report from a caller in the pane.

message.description: The reported message, cleaned of control and bidi characters, for the caller's own pane only; null for other panes and when source is marks. Events never carry it.

kind.description: Present only on a pane tool.open opened, which no caller can send to.

tool.description: Present only with kind: the tool and the arguments it was opened with.
